classes.name: access right
classes.label: Concept representing an access right
classes.comment: Access right (concepts from AT access-right). The restriction applied on access to a resoure.

classes.name: acknowledgment
classes.label: Acknowlegement
classes.comment: "A formal declaration of acknowledgment by the author in which persons and institutions are thanked for their part in the creation of a text" (TEI 4.5)

classes.name: act consolidated layer
classes.label: Consolidated act layer
classes.comment: Consleg couche. Number of the layer

classes.name: act consolidated multiversion
classes.label: Consolidated act multiversion
classes.comment: The multiversion work holds all multiversion AKN4EU instances that contain the complete consolidation process of a basic act so far. The different manifestations will always be overwritten by newer versions.

classes.name: act body agreement international
classes.label: Act of body created by international agreement
classes.comment: Act of body created by international agreement (subsector D of sector 2 in Eur-Lex)

classes.name: act body parliamentary agreement international
classes.label: Act of parliamentary body created by international agreement
classes.comment: Act of parliamentary body created by international agreement (subsector P of sector 2 in Eur-Lex)

classes.name: act consolidated
classes.label: Consolidated act
classes.comment: Consolidated acts (= sector 0): Non-official documents integrating acts of sector 3 with their amendments and corrections. Note: The original VOLET_CONSLEG contains also more fields: * CONSOLID_SEQ: Sequence in the list * CONSOLID_ACT set: Logical grouping element: Used if the act is modified * CONSOLID_ROLE: "IN ou OUT suivant prise en compte dans consolidation" * CONSOLID_FICHE: contains links from the acts to the consolidating acts * BF_NAT, BF, LE and TM are old Consolidation fields that need to be taken into account The pertinence of these fields must be discussed

classes.name: act legislative other oj c
classes.label: OJ C other legislative act
classes.comment: Other legislative acts published in Official Journal C series (subsector Y of sector 3) Examples: 31960Y0317(02), 31962Y1109(03), 31970Y0721(01), 31991Y0419(01), 31990Y0303(03). Remark: There are at present 1189 notices. Other than in sector C the notices referes to legislative acts and they have a real CELEX sector 3 number.

classes.name: act other committee ecsc
classes.label: ECSC Committee other act
classes.comment: 4 European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC) Consultative Committee's other acts (5XK)

classes.name: act other cor
classes.label: Committee of the Regions' other act
classes.comment: 29 Committee of the Regions' other acts (5XR)

classes.name: act other council
classes.label: Other act of the Council
classes.comment: Where its (resource_legal_type = XG, resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_created_by_agent = CONSIL) OR (resource_legal_id_sector = C, work_created_by_agent = CONSIL)

classes.name: act other ec
classes.label: Commission other act
classes.comment: 7868 Other Commission acts (5XC)

classes.name: act other ecb

classes.comment: ECB other acts (5XB)

classes.name: act other eesc
classes.label: European Economic and Social Committee other act
classes.comment: 5 European Economic and Social Committee other acts, mostly resolutions (5XE)

classes.name: act other oj c
classes.label: Other acts in OJ C
classes.comment: Other acts published in Official Journal C series (= subsector Y of sector 4)

classes.name: act other oj l
classes.label: Other acts in OJ L
classes.comment: Other acts published in Official Journal L series (= subsector X of sector 4)

classes.name: act preparatory
classes.label: Preparatory act
classes.comment: As per the decision of the meeting of 2010-05-11 the works in sector 5 will be split in real preparatory acts and others such as the report of the Court of Auditors. They will be distinguished by document type and author (e.g. the opinion of the ECB). The preparatory acts have thus been restructured to clearly distinguish between preparatory acts in a strict sense (COMs etc.) and other types of documents that have traditionally been grouped in sector 5.

classes.name: act preparatory cor
classes.label: Preparatory act by COR
classes.comment: Preparatory act by the Committee of the Regions

classes.name: act preparatory council
classes.label: Preparatory act by Council
classes.comment: Preparatory act by the Council of the European Union; where: resource_legal_type = (AG; KG; XG), resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_created_by_agent = CONSIL, work_has_resource-type = (COMMUNIC, COMPOS, POSIT, STAT_REASON, ACT_PREP, PROP_ACT, ASSENT)

classes.name: act preparatory ec
classes.label: Preparatory act by EC
classes.comment: Preparatory act by the European Commission. A common superclass for all documents of the European Commission emerging from the preparatory work in legislative and non-legislative procedures. All documents from that hierarchy have the European Commission or one of their subentities as author.

classes.name: act preparatory ec document budgetary
classes.label: Preparatory act by EC budgetary document
classes.comment: Budgetary document as Commission preparatory act

classes.name: act preparatory eca
classes.label: Preparatory act by ECA

classes.comment: Preparatory act by the European Parliament

classes.comment: 810 Other organs' or bodies' preparatory acts, e.g. national governments (5XX)

classes.name: act standing committee efta
classes.label: Act of EFTA Standing Committee
classes.comment: Act of European Free Trade Association (EFTA) Standing Committee (= subsector G of sector E in EUR-Lex)

classes.name: act surveillance authority efta
classes.label: Act of EFTA Surveillance Authority
classes.comment: Act of the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) Surveillance Authority (= subsector C of sector E in EUR-Lex)

classes.name: advocate general
classes.label: Advocate general
classes.comment: Advocate general at the Court of Justice

classes.name: agent
classes.label: Agent
classes.comment: "A resource that acts or has the power to act. Examples of Agent include person, organization, and software agent" (Dublin Core)

classes.name: agent conceptual
classes.label: Concept representing an agent
classes.comment: Named and known agents, i.e. an institution, or a country, that are defined by specific authority tables.

classes.name: agent textual
classes.label: Textual agent
classes.comment: Named agents which are not represented in an authority table = "ad hoc agent", not conceptualized, only identified by its name.

classes.name: agreement provisional
classes.label: Agreement provisional
classes.comment: Provisional agreement between EP and Council as result of interinstitutional negociations (trilogue).

classes.name: agreement international
classes.label: International agreement
classes.comment: International agreements (= sector 2 in EUR-Lex)

classes.name: agreement international efta
classes.label: EFTA international agreement
classes.comment: European Free Trade Association (EFTA) international agreement (= subsector A of sector E in EUR-Lex). The EFTA international agreement is implicitly also a subclass of agreement_international and can use the relationships stored_by and has_type_comment (cf. below)

classes.name: agreement member states
classes.label: Agreement between member states
classes.comment: Agreement between member states (= subsector A of sector 4)

classes.name: agreement non member states
classes.label: Agreement with non-member states
classes.comment: Agreement with non-member states or international organizations (subsector A of sector 2 in Eur-Lex)

classes.name: agreement other

classes.comment: Other type of acts (subsector X of sector 2 in Eur-Lex)

classes.name: alinea

classes.comment: Subdivision alinea

classes.name: annex
classes.label: Annex
classes.comment: "an addition to a document" (OED)

classes.name: annex publication general
classes.label: Annex publication general
classes.comment: Supplementary publication that provides additional information to another publication.

classes.name: annex study
classes.label: Annex study
classes.comment: Annex to a study document

classes.name: annex study evaluation
classes.label: Annex study evaluation
classes.comment: Annex to an evaluation study document

classes.name: appendix
classes.label: Appendix
classes.comment: An ancillary self-contained section of a work, often providing additional but in some sense extra-canonical text (TEI 4.7)

classes.name: archive package
classes.label: Archive Package
classes.comment: The archive_package class is a generic class for compound digitised documents. As such it is a container for one or more digitised documents.

classes.name: archive package document
classes.label: Archive package document
classes.comment: An archive package document is a document contained in an archive package but most probably not available in/with a separate manifestation. However, a minimum level of metadata has to be available for such a document in order to establish a work with at least one expression (e.g. titles, identfiers).

classes.name: archive package ec
classes.label: Archive package from European Commission digitisation projects
classes.comment: The archive_package_ec class is a generic class for scanned documents from the OIB HAS archives, done in the scope of digiCOM/digiSEC projects.

classes.name: archive package eesc
classes.label: Archive package from the European Economic and Social Committee digitisation projects
classes.comment: An archive package of internal/official documents of the EESC in the scope of their contribution to legislative procedures. Besides the manifestation representing the digitised "folder" of documents for a given legislative procedure the package also contains metadata referring to the contained singular documents which however are not represented by their own manifestations, but only as metadata.

classes.name: archive package eesc document
classes.label: Archive package document by EESC
classes.comment: The archive packages created in the scope of the EESC digitisation project(s) will provide in their metadata also the list of documents contained in the archive package in form of an ordered list of titles. Additional information (like EESC internal identifiers or the starting page of the different documents) may be provided to enrich the information on an EESC archive package document.

classes.name: arrangement institutional
classes.label: Institutional arrangement
classes.comment: Institutional arrangements: rules of procedure; internal agreements (subsector Q of sector 3). At present 267 notices. Examples: 31953Q0003, 31957Q0002, 31969Q0491, 32009Q0716(02), 32005Q1029(01)

classes.name: article legal
classes.label: Article
classes.comment: An article in a legal document

classes.name: article publishing
classes.label: Article in publishing
classes.comment: A piece of nonfictional prose that is an independent part of a publication (wikipedia). The naming is inspired by Wikipedia's terminology (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Article_%28publishing%29)

classes.name: assent ceca council
classes.label: Council Assent ECSC (CECA)
classes.comment: 721 Council Assent ECSC (5KG)

classes.name: assessment impact summary ec

classes.comment: Summary of Impact Assessment documents for the European Commission

classes.name: asset classification
classes.label: Concept representing an asset classification
classes.comment: Classification of an asset (concepts from AT asset-classification)

classes.name: atto fd
classes.label: ATTO FD table
classes.comment: Legacy metadata definition tables (codes and labels in all official languages) created and maintained with the (also legacy) ATTO (Atelier des Tables de Traduction de l'Office des publications) system. ATTO tables are used in CDM until replaced by semantically more to the point authority tables provided by the EU Vocabularies.

classes.name: audiovisual
classes.label: Audiovisual
classes.comment: Material that covers still images and audio files as well as material ‘consisting of a sequence of related images, with or without accompanying sound, which is intended to be made available as a motion imagery experience through the use of various devices, regardless of the medium of initial or subsequent fixation or distribution’

classes.name: authority local
classes.label: Local authority
classes.comment: Local authority / town. The list of instances of this class is provided by the Metadata Registry

classes.name: auxiliary work
classes.label: Auxiliary works
classes.comment: Works that derive their validity from the existance of another work to which they refer. Relationships between auxiliary works is modelled on FRBR 5.3.1, table 5.1: - has_successor: work_has_successor_work (e.g. sequel, suceeding works) - has_supplement: work_has_supplement_work (e.g. annex) - summarized_by / summarizes: summary_summarizes_work

classes.name: back
classes.label: Back matter
classes.comment: back matter contains any appendixes, etc. following the main part of a text (TEI, description of back element). Cf. http://www.tei-c.org/release/doc/tei-p5-doc/en/html/DS.html#DSBACK for documentation

classes.name: binding type
classes.label: Concept binding type
classes.comment: Concept representing a type of binding (concepts from AT binding-type)

classes.name: blog
classes.label: Blog
classes.comment: Online continuing resource where a writer or group of writers records their experiences and/or views on a subject; blog posts are arranged in reverse chronological order

classes.name: blog personal
classes.label: Blog personal
classes.comment: A blog written by an individual, possibly not with regularity or only once.

classes.name: blog serial
classes.label: Blog serial
classes.comment: A blog written by an organisation or institution, in a regular rhythm and assigned an ISSN number (which makes them an issue of an ISSN serial work).

classes.name: budget
classes.label: Budget
classes.comment: Super class of all adopted budgetary documents published in the Official Journal.

classes.name: budget amending
classes.label: Amending budget
classes.comment: The amendment of a previously adopted general budget, introduced by the Commission and itself adopted by the Parliament and Council.

classes.name: budget amending draft
classes.label: Draft amending budget
classes.comment: Draft for an amendment to a previous adopted general budget, introduced by the Commission, to be adopted by Parliament and Council. This document holds the numbers for the draft amending budget.

classes.name: budget amending draft explanation
classes.label: Draft amending budget explanation
classes.comment: Draft for an amendment to a previous adopted general budget, introduced by the Commission, to be adopted by Parliament and Council. This document type only explains the reasons for the amendment. The actual numbers for the draft amending budget are available from a document of class cdm:budget-amending-draft.

classes.name: budget general
classes.label: General budget
classes.comment: The adopted budget of the European Union for a given budgetary year. Published in the Official Journal.

classes.name: budget general draft
classes.label: Draft general budget
classes.comment: Draft of the European Union's general budget for a given budgetary year, drafted by the Commission.

classes.name: budget general draft notice
classes.label: Budget general draft notice
classes.comment: Notice on the adoption of a draft general budget by the Commission. The actual numbers for the draft general budget are available from a document of class cdm:budget-general-draft.

classes.name: budget letter amending
classes.label: Amending letter
classes.comment: Amending letters sent by the Commission propose modifications to the draft general budget or a draft amending budget for the same year prior to the adoption by Parliament and Council (quasi: pre-adoption amending budget).

classes.name: budget letter amending draft
classes.label: Draft budget amending letter
classes.comment: Draft amending letters are documents from the internal procedure of the Commission and propose modifications to the draft general/amending budget(s) for the same year prior to the adoption of the latter by Parliament and Council. When adopted, they become amending letters in the interinstitutional budgetary procedure.

classes.name: budget letter amending explanation
classes.label: Budget letter amending explanation
classes.comment: This document only explains the reasons for the numbers in the amending letter. The actual numbers for an amending letter are available from a document of class cdm:budget-letter-amending.

classes.name: budget line by line
classes.label: General budget line by line
classes.comment: Representation in a detailed line by line mode for the adopted general budget.

classes.name: c package ec
classes.label: C package EC
classes.comment: Internal documents of the European Commission with a C type identifier, meanwhile declassified.

classes.name: carrier
classes.label: Concept carrier
classes.comment: Concept for a distribution media (concepts from AT carrier)

classes.name: cartographic
classes.label: Cartographic
classes.comment: Graphic representation drawn to scale of feature – for example, geographical, geological, or geopolitical – of an area of the Earth or of any other celestial body

classes.name: case law
classes.label: Case law
classes.comment: "Real" case law in sector 6 (= a subset of the complete sector 6) and sector 8. Changed to subclass of: resource_legal. Case law of the Court of Justice also inherits from document_cjeu Remarks: * case-law_XXX_resource_legal can all be seen as sub-properties of a generic "affects" property * These fields by and large correspond to the specific fields of the VOLET_CDJ * NOMUSUEL and NOMUSUEL_XX: Appears as title in the corresponding expression

classes.name: case law subject matter
classes.label: Concept representing a subject matter in the scope of CASELAW
classes.comment: Subject matters in the scope of the Court of Justice, in a hierarchical structure (values from AT case-law-subject-matter). This AT is meant to superseed the concepts from AT subject matter formerly used for caselaw.

classes.name: case law national
classes.label: National case law
classes.comment: National case law with relevance to EU law (sector 8)

classes.name: case status
classes.label: Concept representing the status of a court case
classes.comment: Values currently used in the Court schema: ENC, CLOT, SUSP, DESIST Traced in MDR-1938

classes.name: case court
classes.label: Case at a Court
classes.comment: Case at a Court (pending or closed)

classes.name: case court efta pending
classes.label: EFTA pending court case
classes.comment: Pending case of the EFTA Court (= subsector P of sector E)

classes.name: cfsp
classes.label: Common Foreign and Security Policy
classes.comment: Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP). Subsector E of sector 3. At present 642 notices. Examples: 31994E0779, 32004E0794

classes.name: chapter legal
classes.label: Chapter (legal)
classes.comment: A chapter in a legal document. Created to have correspondance to the subdivision NAL

classes.name: citation
classes.label: Citation
classes.comment: A citation in a legal document. Created to have correspondance to the subdivision NAL

classes.name: classification summary
classes.label: Concept representing a classification for summaries of EU legislation
classes.comment: A classification for summaries of EU legislation (concepts from AT class-sum-leg)

classes.name: clause legal
classes.label: Clause
classes.comment: A close in a legal document. Created to have correspondance to the subdivision NAL

classes.name: collection document
classes.label: Concept representing a document collection
classes.comment: A collection of documents (concepts from AT document-collection)

classes.name: collection work
classes.label: Collection work
classes.comment: This class is use to describe a serial work when the publication project is to publish various monographs belonging to a “collection” which gives the editorial line for the monographs.

classes.name: com final
classes.label: Digitised COM final document
classes.comment: Digitized COM final document (a Commission proposal), digitized based on the fonds of the OIB archive. For practical purposes this digitization is treated as a separate work from the "main" Commission proposal that has undergone full legal analysis. It may be related to this COM using cdm:work_is_another_publication_of_work. The exact type of this COM is indicated via cdm: work_has_resource-type, mapped from /oibtrans:oib_transmission_request/cmt:transmission/cmt:workflow/cm:work/cm:type_work The COM identifier (= cdm:work_id_document) can be built based on cmext:prefix, cmext:year and cmext:number. These are individually mapped to annotations to cdm:work_id_document (annotation:prefix, annotation:year, annotation:sequence_number). <cmext:internal_number><cmext:prefix>COM</cmext:prefix><cmext:year>1983</cmext:year><cmext:number>29</cmext:number></cmext:internal_number> cmext:reference_production is mapped to to cdm:work_reference_internal oibext:reference_volume is mapped to cdm:expression_source for the applicable linguistic versions. oibext:size is mapped to the technical metadata tdm:stream_size, oibext:datetime_creation to tdm:creating_application_date_created_by_application (cf. tdm.rdf for details) The link of a COM final and its COM package(s) is expressed at the manifestation level via cdm:manifestation_part_of_manifestation

classes.name: com package
classes.label: Digitised COM package document
classes.comment: Package of digitized documents related to a COM proposal. Historical collection of documents related to a Commission proposal, digitized based on the fonds of the OIB archive. Such COM packages merge typically a number of different documents across linguistic versions in a single multilingual expression. Each expression indicates the languages it uses, each title has in a language tag the corresponding language. The relationship between the COM package and its COM is expressed via work_contains_work. The COM identifier can be built based on ext:prefix_com, ext:year_com and ext:number_com.

classes.name: committee
classes.label: Committee
classes.comment: A group of representatives from EU countries assisting the Commission for implementing acts during the internal decision-making process

classes.name: committee ep
classes.label: Committee EP
classes.comment: Any EP committee preparing or contributing to the text for adoption by the plenary.

classes.name: committee lead ep
classes.label: Committee lead ep
classes.comment: EP committee leading the work on a legislative proposal, formulating the position of the EP to be adopted by the plenary. The lead committee provides also the reporter(s) and has a shadow reporter (facilitator).

classes.name: committee opinion ep
classes.label: Committee opinion ep
classes.comment: The EP opinion giving committee contributes to the work of the lead committee by detailing the matter from the perspective of the committee´s subjects.

classes.name: committee council

classes.name: concept
classes.label: Concept

classes.name: concept com internal event
classes.label: Concept representing a Commission internal event
classes.comment: Internal event from a Commission internal procedure (concepts from AT com_internal_event)

classes.name: concept com internal procedure
classes.label: Concept representing a Commission internal procedure

classes.name: concept court procedure
classes.label: Concept representing a court procedure

classes.name: concept legal basis court procedure

classes.comment: Corresponds to the contents of the MDR authority list data-theme

classes.name: concept treaty

classes.name: court report
classes.label: Court report
classes.comment: The Reports of Cases before the Court of Justice and the General Court. The Reports of Cases before the Court of Justice and the General Court, generally known as Court Reports, publishes the collections of documents that belong to one case (e.g. Summary of the Judgment, Opinion of Advocate General and Judgment of the Court). Structually, one publication consists of: - the front matter including the index of subject matter and the table of contents - a series of cases, each in turn composed of the individual documents Some of these documents are already part of sector 6 (e.g. Opinion of Advocate General and Judgment of the Court), others not, e.g. the front matter and the summary. The CDM must therefore model some parts of the court documents as well. To make things more complicated, the summary of the case is in the Court Report separated from the judgement and introduces the complete case (e.g. ECR 2010-1, p. 1f) and joined to the judgement itself in EUR-Lex (e.g. celex 62008CJ0229). A number of key properties such as catalogue number and ISSN are modelled on the manifestation level as they can vary according to the type of manifestation chosen (e.g. print vs. eBook). One number (= fascicle) of the Court Report can be split over multiple volumes that are conventionally numbered with Latin capital letters, e.g. "2010 - 1 (A)" and "2010 - 1 (B)". They are consecutively numbered so that "2010 - 1 (A)" ends with page 486 and "2010 - 1 (B)" starts with page 487. Only the first volume has the front-matter (except for the title page). The CDM therefore treats these volumes as part of one work and only distinguishes the parts of the full Court Report at the item level (i.e. as parts of the various manifestation of the full Court Report). This is, however, probably not in line with the current practice in EU-Bookshop. However, as long as the partial catalogue numbers are stored, the Court Reports would be finable both by the "global catalogue number" that is manifestation wide (i.e. for one manifestation of the complete fascicle) and by a catalogue number essentially on item level. The page numbers that an legal resource appears on are part of the legal resource's print publication. So, an individual case law expression will be linked to a manifestation_print that in turn is lnked to the work of the Court Report.

Information on National implementing measures aka NIMs are currently typically expressed in VOLET_MNE (MNE: mésure nationale d'exécution = NIM). This volet contains references to the national implementing measures enacted in order to comply with European directives. The volet is usually directly fed by data issued by the Secretariat General. Note: Information on National Implementing Measures are currently partially encoded as "true" sector 7 document, but for the most part they are stored in the VOLET_MNE of their "mother" directive. However, for conversion these must become their own objects, only linked to the directive(s) they implement. As an example the <VOLET_MNE> of the Council directive Council Directive 2009/158/EC of 30 November 2009 (= 32009L0158) on "animal health conditions governing intra-Community trade in, and imports from third countries of, poultry and hatching eggs" that shows how the country codes are used to encode the title(s) of the NIMs belonging to a given directive. The number of different implementing measures can vary per country. {code} <VOLET_MNE><DE>1. - Neunte Verordnung zur Änderung der Binnenmarkt-Tiersuchenverordnung vom 27. März 2006</DE><DE>2. - Zehnte Verordnung zur Änderung der Binnenmarkt-Tierseuchenschutzverordnung vom 11. Dezember 2006</DE><DE>3. - Bekanntmachung der Neufassung der Binnenmarkt-Tierseuchenschutzverordnung vom 6. April 2005</DE><LV>1. - Mājputnu un inkubējamo olu aprites kārtība</LV><CZ>1. - Zákon č. 131/2003 Sb., kterým se mění zákon č. 166/1999 Sb., o veterinární péči a o změně některých souvisejících zákonů (veterinární zákon), ve znění pozdějších předpisů, a některé další zákony</CZ> [...] <CZ>8. - Vyhláška č. 12/2010 Sb., kterou se mění vyhláška č. 299/2003 Sb., o opatřeních pro předcházení a zdolávání nákaz a nemocí přenosných ze zvířat na člověka, ve znění pozdějších předpisů</CZ><CZ>9. - Zákon č. 182/2008 Sb., kterým se mění zákon č. 166/1999 Sb., o veterinární péči a o změně některých souvisejících zákonů (veterinární zákon), ve znění pozdějších předpisů, zákon č. 634/2004 Sb., o správních poplatcích, ve znění pozdějších předpisů, a zákon č. 154/2000 Sb., o šlechtění, plemenitbě a evidenci hospodářských zvířat a o změně některých souvisejících zákonů (plemenářský zákon), ve znění pozdějších předpisů</CZ> [...] </VOLET_MNE> {code}

classes.name: meeting
classes.label: Meeting
classes.comment: The meeting is a generic class for all kind of official assemblies of European bodies like the European Institutions or one of their subentities, but also ad hoc working groups.

classes.name: meeting college
classes.label: College meeting
classes.comment: Meeting of the College of Commissioners of the European Commission

classes.name: meeting conciliation committee
classes.label: Meeting conciliation committee
classes.comment: In the meetins fo the conciliation committee the European Parliament and the Council of Europe discuss finally legislative proposals which in the previous phases of the legislative procedure could not be resolved with a common viewpoint. The European Commission attends the conciliation meetings in the capacity of an observer.

classes.name: meeting council
classes.label: Council meeting
classes.comment: Any formal meeting of bodies in the Council of Europe. This includes working parties as much as COREPER and other specific meetings. The outcomes of the meetings are usually documented as events in the interinstitutional procedures.

classes.name: meeting ec
classes.label: Commission meeting
classes.comment: Any meeting in the European Commission.

classes.name: meeting ep
classes.label: Meeting EP
classes.comment: Any meeting in the European Parliament including part-sessions.

classes.name: meeting ep committee
classes.label: Meeting EP committee
classes.comment: Meeting of a parliamentary committee in EP in scope of the interinstitutional procedures.

classes.name: meeting ep delegation
classes.label: Meeting EP delegation
classes.comment: A delegation meeting in the European Parliament.

classes.name: meeting interinstitutional
classes.label: Meeting interinstitutional
classes.comment: Any meeting between multiple European institutions or bodies

classes.name: meeting doc council
classes.label: Council meeting document
classes.comment: The majority of these documents are related to Council meetings (minutes, list of items, ...), where resource_legal_type = none, resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_created_by_agent = CONSIL, work_has_resource-type = (VOTING_RES, NOTE)

classes.name: monograph
classes.label: Monograph
classes.comment: Non-serial publication complete in one volume or a definite number of volumes

classes.name: monolanguage
classes.label: Concept representing a singular language
classes.comment: A singular language (concepts from AT language)

classes.name: multilingual
classes.label: Concept representing a combination of languages
classes.comment: A fixed combination of languages (concepts from AT multilingual)

classes.name: national parliament eums
classes.label: EU member-state national parliament
classes.comment: A national parliament or parliamentary chamber of an EU member-state as agent. Values from AT corporate-body, restricted by AT corporate-body-classification.

classes.name: newspaper
classes.label: Newspaper
classes.comment: Continuing resource issued at stated and frequent intervals, usually daily, weekly or semi-weekly and that reports events and discusses topics of general current interest.

classes.name: non opposition concentration notified
classes.label: Non-opposition to notified concentration
classes.comment: Non-opposition to a notified concentration (= subsector 3M of sector 3). At present 3924 notices. Examples: 31990M0004, 31991M0021, 32010M5760

classes.name: non opposition joint venture notified
classes.label: Non-opposition to notified joint venture
classes.comment: Non-opposition to a notified joint venture (= subsector 3J of sector 3). At present 43 notices. Examples: 31998J0001, 32000J0048

classes.name: official journal
classes.label: Official Journal
classes.comment: The Official Journal itself

classes.name: official journal act
classes.label: Official Journal act
classes.comment: This class establishes the Official Journal in its act-by-act publication form; it holds all properties that represent an OJ act, including corrigenda to those. I.e. the properties from which the identification is built have to be represented. In order to hold the business specific aspects of a legal act, the objects having this class here will also be typed as cdm#resource_legal

classes.name: oj c
classes.label: OJ C series
classes.comment: Other documents published in the Official Journal C Series (= sector C in EUR-Lex) . Sector C effectively has only one subsector called again C, so no further subclasses are needed.

classes.name: opinion
classes.label: Opinion
classes.comment: Opinion (subsector A of sector 3). Examples: 31968A0336, 31977A0674, 32009A1013(03)R(01),32009A1121(01)

classes.name: opinion committee ep
classes.label: Opinion committee EP
classes.comment: Opinion of an EP opinion giving committee with respect to the lead committee's work on a legislative proposal.

classes.name: opinion np eums
classes.label: Opinion of EU member-state national parliament
classes.comment: The opinion of an EU member-state national parliament

classes.name: opinion own initiative np eums
classes.label: Opinion own-initiative of EU member-state national parliament
classes.comment: The own-initiative opinion of an EU member-state national parliament

classes.name: opinion political dialogue np eums
classes.label: Opinion political dialogue of EU member-state national parliament
classes.comment: The opinion of an EU member-state national parliament as political dialogue in reaction on the proposal of the Commission in scope of an interinstitutional procedure

classes.name: opinion reasoned np eums
classes.label: Reasoned opinion of EU member-state national parliament
classes.comment: The reasoned opinion of an EU member-state national parliament as reaction on the proposal of the Commission in scope of an interinstitutional procedure

classes.name: opinion advocate general
classes.label: Opinion of advocate general
classes.comment: Opinion of the advocate general in sector 6 (6CC/6TC). Currently encoded by table FD

classes.name: opinion cjeu
classes.label: Opinion of the Court of Justice
classes.comment: Opinion of the Court of Justice in sector 6 (= type 6CV)

classes.name: opinion consultation cor
classes.label: Committee of the Regions' opinion on consultation
classes.comment: 709 Committee of the Regions' opinions on consultation (5AR)

classes.name: opinion consultation eesc
classes.label: European Economic and Social Committee opinion on consultation
classes.comment: European Economic and Social Committee Opinion on consultation (5AE)

classes.name: opinion ec
classes.label: Commission opinion
classes.comment: 313 Commission opinions (5, not PC, with FM=AVIS OR OPIN). Examples: 52011SC1503: Commission opinion appointment of members of the european economic and social committee 52011DC0816: Commission Opinion on the independent expert evaluation on the EIT

classes.name: opinion ec ep amendments
classes.label: EC Opinion on European Parliament's amendments
classes.comment: where its resource_legal_type = (PC or DC), resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = OPIN_AMEND_EP

classes.name: opinion eca
classes.label: Court of Auditors opinion
classes.comment: 145 Court of Auditors opinions, usually on draft legislation and requested by another institution (5AA)

classes.name: opinion ecb
classes.label: European Central Bank opinion
classes.comment: European Central Bank opinions, usually on draft legislation and requested by another institution (5AB)

classes.name: opinion eesc
classes.label: European Economic and Social Committee opinion
classes.comment: European Economic and Social Committee opinions, usually on non-obligatory consultation on draft legislation or communications (5AC)

classes.name: opinion other committee ecsc
classes.label: ECSC Committee other opinion
classes.comment: where its resource_legal_type = AK, resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = OPIN

classes.name: opinion other cor
classes.label: Committee of the Regions' other opinion
classes.comment: 291 Committee of the Regions' other opinions (5IR)

classes.name: opinion other eesc
classes.label: European Economic and Social Committee other opinion
classes.comment: European Economic and Social Committee other opinions, usually own-initiative (celex 5IE)

classes.name: order cjeu
classes.label: Court order
classes.comment: Order in sector 6 (6CO/6TO/6FO)

classes.name: organization
classes.label: Organization
classes.comment: Organization (typically private)

classes.name: paragraph legal
classes.label: Paragraph (legal)
classes.comment: A paragraph in a legal document

classes.name: part session ep
classes.label: EP part-session
classes.comment: Part sessions of the European parliament cover the period of a session week (usually 4 days) with sittings each day in which the tabled agenda items are handled. The different part sessions within one year form the session cycle of the European Parliament.

classes.name: part legal
classes.label: Part (legal)
classes.comment: A part in a legal document

classes.name: period
classes.label: Period
classes.comment: "This class comprises sets of coherent phenomena or cultural manifestations bounded in time and space. It is the social or physical coherence of these phenomena that identify an E4 Period and not the associated spatio-temporal bounds." (CIDOC CRM)

classes.name: periodical work
classes.label: Periodical Work
classes.comment: This class describes a serial work such as news-paper, news-letter, journal… Each work member of the periodical_work has the same name but a completely new content.

classes.name: person
classes.label: Person
classes.comment: The FOAF vocabulary http://xmlns.com/foaf/spec can be used to specify other attributes such as name, email addresses etc. as applicable and needed. Such attributes are however currently not covered in Procat. http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Person If we want to map a person specifically to an authority table (e.g. FD table 013 or 014) this works with inScheme to the appropriate table, e.g. FD 014 in this case: <CMROntology:document_budget_ep_reported_by_person><CMROntology:ATTO_FD_014 rdf:about="http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/fd_014/AALTONEN"><skos:inScheme xmlns:skos="http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#" rdf:resource="&cellar-authority;/fd_014"/></CMROntology:ATTO_FD_014></CMROntology:document_budget_ep_reported_by_person> The person is then correctly decoded using the authority table in question

classes.name: physical dimension
classes.label: Concept representing a physical dimension
classes.comment: Physical dimension of a publication object (concepts from AT physical-dimension)

classes.name: place
classes.label: Concept representing a place
classes.comment: Named and known places, i.e. a town, a village where events relevant for the European Union took place or were described or actioned (concepts from AT place). Corresponds to FRBRoo object type "E44 Place Appellation".

classes.name: point
classes.label: Point
classes.comment: Subdivision point

classes.name: position council
classes.label: Council position
classes.comment: Council position after Lisbon treaty and its statement of reasons (= 5AG after 1.12.2009, entry into force of Lisbon Treaty). Its equivalent authority codes are POSIT for position in the OJ workflow (sent by the Council with the code "ACT_LEGIS" in the preleg flow) and STAT_REASON for Statement of reasons. Note: Council position in ATTO FD_030 is FM=PO, before the Lisbon treaty it was Council common position FM=POCO. Resource types mapped on this class for the Council: - STAT_REASON - STAT_REASON_DRAFT - POSIT - ACT_LEGIS (if cm:type_event is ADP_R1_POS_byCONSIL and type_interinstitutionaprocedure is OLP)

classes.name: preamble
classes.label: Preamble
classes.comment: Subdivision preamble

classes.name: preface
classes.label: Preface
classes.comment: "A foreword or preface addressed to the reader in which the author or publisher explains the content, purpose, or origin of the text" (TEI 4.5)

classes.name: pricing info
classes.label: Pricing info
classes.comment: price info of a manifestation

classes.name: procedure budgetary
classes.label: Budgetary procedure
classes.comment: An interinstitutional procedure in which the EU budget is decided. The procedure is usually initiated by draft budget proposal of the European Commission. The procedure code is BUD.

classes.name: procedure phase
classes.label: Concept procedure phase
classes.comment: Concept representing entries of AT procedure-phase to describe the phase of a legislative procedure in which an event occured.

classes.name: procedure priority interinstitutional
classes.label: Priority interinstitutional procedure
classes.comment: Any interinstitutional procedure which is linked to a legislative priority of a joint declaration of the legislating institutions. This subclass of cdm:procedure_code_interinstitutional governs the restriction for a relation between a legislative priority object and the procedure object which by the link makes it a "priority procedure".

classes.name: procedure code interinstitutional
classes.label: Procedure with interinstitutional code
classes.comment: A procedure from its initiation to its conclusion. Procedures cover legislative or non-legislative procedures as defined in this data model from the initial Commission proposal to its eventual adoption and beyond. Procedures with an interinstitutional code are the typical case of procedures leading to new secondary legislation.

classes.name: procedure interinstitutional
classes.label: Legislative/non-legislative procedure involving the European institutions or being initiated by them.
classes.comment: Any dossier (jargon for all events in the interinstutional procedures) from its initiation to its conclusion. Every instance is classified into one of its two subclasses.

classes.name: procedure interinstitutional split
classes.label: Procedure interinstitutional split
classes.comment: This interinstitutional procedure is one of the successors of an original procedure that was split in 2 new procedures. Each split procedure will continue the necessary steps until signature or rejection. Split procedures can be detected by the procedure number having appended an "A" or "B" letter compared with the original procedure.

classes.name: procedure internal
classes.label: Internal procedure
classes.comment: The internal procedure of a European institution or body. Usually this is governed by the institution's "rules of procedure".

classes.name: procedure internal ec
classes.label: Commission internal procedure
classes.comment: The European Commission executes a series of internal workflows (= internal procedure) in order to prepare legislative proposals. Their entirety constitutes a COM initiative (cdm:initiative-ec).

classes.name: procedure internal eesc
classes.label: Procedure internal EESC
classes.comment: The internal procedure of the European Economic and Social Committee.

classes.name: procedure without code interinstitutional
classes.label: Procedure without interinstitutional code
classes.comment: A procedure initiated usually by the Commission, but not having an inter-institutional procedure code. The dossier does not follow one of the (non-)legislative procedures represented in this data model. In any case, a dossier consists of one or more events. Such a dossier could also lead to the adoption of a new act (Eg.: COM (2010) 2010))

classes.name: proceeding third party
classes.label: Third party proceeding
classes.comment: Third party proceeding in sector 6 (6CT/6TT/6FT)

classes.name: proceedings
classes.label: Proceedings
classes.comment: Published record of a conference, congress, symposium or other meeting usually but not necessarily including abstracts, reports of papers or full text of papers presented by the participants.

classes.name: procjur
classes.label: Concept representing judicial procedures (procédures juridictionnelles)
classes.comment: Corresponds to the procjur table

classes.name: procjur type
classes.label: Concept representing types of procedures in a court case
classes.comment: Values currently used in the Court schema: R, I, P Traced in MDR-1936

classes.name: procresult
classes.label: Concept representing the resoult of a judicial procedure (résultats de procédure)
classes.comment: Corresponds to the procresult table

classes.name: procurement public
classes.label: Public procurement
classes.comment: Any of the works related to public procurement (Ted)

classes.name: product form
classes.label: Product form concept
classes.comment: Concept of a product form from authority table product-form (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/product-form)

classes.name: proposal act
classes.label: Proposal for an act
classes.comment: The natural number of the COM can be encoded as id All Commission legislative proposals (proposal) are currently 5PC documents. The class proposal should accordingly NOT take the joint-proposal_decision, joint-proposal_directive and joint-proposal_regulation. They should go to their specific sub-classes.

classes.name: proposal decision codified ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a codified decision
classes.comment: 17 Commission Proposal Codified Decision (5GC)

classes.name: proposal decision ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a decision
classes.comment: where its resource_legal_type = (PC or DC or NONE), resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = (PROP_DEC, AMEND_PROP_DEC, DEC_DRAFT, DEC_DEL_DRAFT, DEC_FRAMW_DRAFT, PROP_DEC_NO_ADDRESSEE, PROP_DEC_FRAMW, PROP_DEC_IMPL, RECO_DEC)

classes.name: proposal decision implementing ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for an implementing decision

classes.name: proposal directive codified ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a codified directive
classes.comment: 77 Commission Proposal Codified Directive(5FC)

classes.name: proposal directive ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a directive
classes.comment: where its resource_legal_type = (PC or NONE), resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = (PROP_DIR, AMEND_PROP_DIR, DIR_DRAFT, DIR_DEL_DRAFT, DIR_IMPL_DRAFT, PROP_DIR_IMPL, ANNEX)

classes.name: proposal directive implementing ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for an implementing directive

classes.name: proposal other
classes.label: Other proposal for an act
classes.comment: Other Proposal, e.g. of the Commission or the Joint Staff

classes.name: proposal regulation codified ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a codified regulation
classes.comment: Commission Proposal Codified Regulation (5EC)

classes.name: proposal regulation ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for a regulation
classes.comment: where its resource_legal_type = PC, resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = (PROP_REG, AMEND_PROP_REG, REG_DRAFT, REG_DEL_DRAFT, REG_IMPL_DRAFT, PROP_REG_IMPL, RECO_REG, ANNEX)

classes.name: proposal regulation implementing ec
classes.label: Commission proposal for an implementing regulation
classes.comment: Note: There is consciously no proposal for an delegated regulation (in Procat: 5PC with FM = PDIRDEL), an delegated directive (FM = PDIRIMP) and a delegated decision (FM = PDECIMP)

classes.name: pub theme
classes.label: Pub theme
classes.comment: A concept representing a publication theme categorization (concepts from AT pub-theme); this class replaces the former "op_theme" to maintain the naming conversion version 2.

classes.name: publication accessibility
classes.label: Publication accessibility concept
classes.comment: Corresponds to the contents of authority table publication-accessibility (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/publication-accessibility)

classes.name: publication other
classes.label: Other publication
classes.comment: Other types of publications that do not fall into one of the previous classes (e.g. gadgets serving as advertisements, but not contents)

classes.name: publication work
classes.label: Publication work
classes.comment: publication_work will be used to describe an aggregation of components which form a single publication product

classes.name: question oral
classes.label: Oral question
classes.comment: Oral parliamentary question (= subsector O sector 9 in EUR-Lex, 2451 notices on 2010-07-27)

classes.name: question parliamentary
classes.label: Parliamentary question
classes.comment: Parliamentary questions (= sector 9 in EUR-Lex)

classes.name: question parliamentary question time
classes.label: Question at question time
classes.comment: Parliamentary question at question time (= subsector H sector 9 in EUR-Lex, 20873 notices on 2010-07-27)

classes.name: question written
classes.label: Written question
classes.comment: Written parliamentary question (= subsector E sector 9 in EUR-Lex, 89929 notices on 2010-07-27)

classes.name: recital
classes.label: Recital
classes.comment: A recital in a legal document . Created to have correspondance to the subdivision NAL

classes.name: recommendation
classes.label: Recommendation
classes.comment: Recommendation (subsector H of sector 3). At present 706 notices. Examples: 31960H1221,31963H0660, 32004H0705, 32010H0191

classes.name: recommendation ec
classes.label: Commission recommendation for an act
classes.comment: 419 Commission recommendation for an act work_has_resource-type = (RECO_DEC, RECO, CORRIGENDUM) resource_legal_type= (DC OR SC OR PC OR XC)

classes.name: recommendation ecb
classes.label: European Central Bank recommendation
classes.comment: ECB recommendations, usually based on the Statute of the European System of Central Banks and of the ECB (5HB)

classes.name: recommendation ecsc
classes.label: ECSC recommendation
classes.comment: Recommendation of the European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC) (subsector K of sector 3). At present 152 notices. Examples: 31959K0211, 31978K0617, 31996K2393R(01)

classes.name: recording audio
classes.label: Recording audio
classes.comment: An audio-only recording

classes.name: recording video
classes.label: Recording video
classes.comment: An audio-video recording

classes.name: recording work
classes.label: Recording work
classes.comment: A recording work has contents that are recordings of still or moving character, with or without sound. They correspond to FRBRoo object type F22 Recording Work.

classes.name: reference data
classes.label: Reference data
classes.comment: Reference data dataset works for the assets, their documentation and publication

classes.name: reference data asset
classes.label: Reference data asset
classes.comment: A dataset representing a reference data asset like an authority table, a thesaurus, a taxonomy in all of its formats (provided in the different distribution manifestations). The documentation of a publication is represented by a linked object with class cdm:reference-data-documentation.

classes.name: reference data asset prerelease
classes.label: Pre-release of reference data asset
classes.comment: A prerelease version of the a reference data asset, marked as not being "official". It does not necessarily have a documentation link and is not linked to any publication but only to a reference data asset release as base version from which it is derived and the representative work of the asset.

classes.name: reference data asset release
classes.label: Release of reference data asset
classes.comment: A dataset representing a specific version of a reference data asset which has an unversioned representative in cdm:reference-data-asset-representative. The documentation of a release is represented by a linked object with class cdm:reference-data-documentation.

classes.name: reference data asset representative
classes.label: Reference data asset representative
classes.comment: The representative work for a reference data asset. It represents the asset and gives access to all its - linked - releases, prereleases and publications.

classes.name: reference data asset versioned
classes.label: Versioned reference data asset
classes.comment: Release and prerelease reference data assets have a version, in contrary to the representative which groups all versions. This class is meant to provide version support for the release and prerelease classes.

classes.name: reference data publication
classes.label: Publication of reference data asset(s)
classes.comment: A dataset representing a (potentially complex) publication of reference data assets. The manifestations of such a dataset contain the zipped assets. The documentation of a publication is represented by a linked object with class cdm:documentation.

classes.name: reference data standardization request
classes.label: Reference data standardization request
classes.comment: Standardization requests are used for the process of creating or modifying a reference data asset. The documents describe the requested modification, the request elaboration, the suggested solution and other circumstancial information. Furthermore, they document potential governance steps like presentation to the governance body or approval/adoption. In the restrictions only the adoption date is required, assuming that the document will not be published if there was no adoption (yet) or if there was a rejection by the governance body.

classes.name: region
classes.label: Region
classes.comment: Region of a country (e.g. a Land in Germany)

classes.name: regularity
classes.label: Concept representing the publication regularity
classes.comment: Corresponds to the publication regularity (values from AT regularity)

classes.name: regulation
classes.label: Regulation
classes.comment: Regulation (subsector R of sector 3). At present 75662 notices

classes.name: regulation delegated
classes.label: Delegated regulation
classes.comment: 229 Delegated regulation (DTS=3 AND FM=REGDEL)

classes.name: regulation implementing
classes.label: Implementing regulation
classes.comment: 18 Implementing regulation (DTS=3 AND FM=REGIMP)

classes.name: reply opinion np eums ec
classes.label: Reply opinion NP by EC
classes.comment: European Commission reply to an opinion from a memberstate national parliament chamber on a Commission proposal

classes.name: reply opinion own initiative np eums ec
classes.label: Reply opinion own-initiative NP by EC
classes.comment: European Commission reply to a own-initiative opinion from a memberstate national parliament chamber on a Commission proposal

classes.name: reply opinion political dialogue np eums ec
classes.label: Reply opinion political-dialogue NP by EC
classes.comment: European Commission reply to a political-dialogue opinion from a memberstate national parliament chamber on a Commission proposal

classes.name: reply opinion reasoned np eums ec
classes.label: Reply opinion reasoned NP by EC
classes.comment: European Commission reply to a reasoned opinion from a memberstate national parliament chamber on a Commission proposal

classes.name: report
classes.label: Report
classes.comment: A super class for any kind of report

classes.name: report certification
classes.label: Report certification
classes.comment: Type of report used for the completion of a certification process.

classes.name: report committee ep
classes.label: Report committee ep
classes.comment: The report of the EP lead committee as basis of the vote of the EP plenary.

classes.name: report final
classes.label: Report final
classes.comment: Document published at the end of a project/programme detailing the methodology, general findings and the results.

classes.name: report project
classes.label: Report project
classes.comment: Document published after a milestone of a project to record officially the activities undertaken during implementation or to present findings.

classes.name: report surveillance
classes.label: Report surveillance
classes.comment: Document that presents results using data from a surveillance programme.

classes.name: report synthesis
classes.label: Report synthesis
classes.comment: Document that further distils and integrates materials, findings and views elicited from other reports.

classes.name: report technical
classes.label: Report technical
classes.comment: Document describing the process, progress or results of technical or scientific research or the state of a technical or scientific research problem.

classes.name: report case
classes.label: Case report
classes.comment: Case report in sector 6 (6CP)

classes.name: report ec
classes.label: Commission report
classes.comment: 2573 Commission report (5DC with FM=RAPPORT)

classes.name: report eca
classes.label: Court of Auditors report
classes.comment: 215 Court of Auditors reports, usually the annual report (5TA)

classes.name: report ep
classes.label: European Parliament report
classes.comment: Report issued by a committee conformant to the Rules of Procedure of the European Parliament, Rule 47/1)

classes.name: report joint
classes.label: Joint report
classes.comment: resource_legal_type = (JC or DC), resource_legal_id_sector = 5, work_has_resource-type = JOINT_REPORT

classes.name: report special eca
classes.label: Court of Auditors special report
classes.comment: Court of Auditors special reports (5SA)

classes.name: resolution
classes.label: Resolution
classes.comment: Resolution (subsector G of sector 3). At present 128 notices. Examples: 31962G0420(01), 32002G0124(01), 32009G1030(01)

classes.name: resolution initiative own ep
classes.label: Parliament own-initiative resolution
classes.comment: 5094 Parliament own-initiative resolution (DTT=IP OR AP AND FM=OWNINI_RES)

classes.name: resolution legislative
classes.label: Legislative resolution

classes.name: signature digital
classes.label: Digital signature
classes.comment: A digital signature in the Commission model is a standalone signature file related to (typically) one OJ, Special Edition of the OJ or Court report with all its expressions and pdf manifestations (full and toc) as well as all its acts. It is a plain vanilla work with the only special relationship "signs". No specific properties are defined for their expressions (per default, the language "English" should be set) and manifestations. Manifestations point to XML files with names such as CE2010256.sig.xml Two signatures are sent, one being the main signature itself (signature XAdES-T and XAdES-A = archival electronic signatures). At the date of publishing of the electronic OJ (pdf on eurlex) only XAdES-T signature will be available, XAdES-A signatures will be added to the CELLAR as soon as they become available. It will replace the original XAdES-T file of the manifestation. In principle, it is always the individual PDF/A-1a manifestation that is signed: {code} +--------------------------------------+ +-----------------------------------------+ | +-----------------------+ | | +--------------------------------+ | | | Digital Signature | |-- | | Work (e.g. OJ or act) | | | +-----------------------+ | \- . | +--------------------------------+ | | | \- | | +--------------------------------------+ \- +-----------------------------------------+ \- \- - +--------------------------------------+ \- Signs / +-----------------------------------------+ | +-----------------------+ | \- | +-------------------------------+ | | | Expression | | \- Signed by | | Expression | | | +-----------------------+ | \- | +-------------------------------+ | | Fixed title | \- | | +--------------------------------------+ \- +-----------------------------------------+ \- \- +--------------------------------------+ \- +-------------------------------------------+ | +-----------------------+ | \- | +-----------------------------+ | | | Manifestation - | | \+ | Manifestation (pdfa1a) | | - | +-----------------------+ | | +-----------------------------+ | | Signature (xml), Type | | | +--------------------------------------+ +-------------------------------------------+ +--------------------------------------+ | +-----------------------+ | | | Item | | | +-----------------------+ | | | +--------------------------------------+ {code} Once signatures are up for renewal, typically after a period of four years, this might be captured e.g. by adding a new manifestation encapsulating this file. Alternatively, the current manifestation might be updated to contain the renewed signature. This question will be clarified at the appropriate moment in collaboration with Dokumenta, the company providing the signature system.
